title: LinkedIn Larpmaxxing
summary: A satirical blog post titled 'LinkedIn Larpmaxxing' that critiques the culture of performative self-promotion on LinkedIn, likely mocking AI/tech influencers who exaggerate their expertise. The piece gained traction on Hacker News with 256 points and 215 comments, sparking discussion about authenticity, career signaling, and the blurring line between genuine skill and online persona in the AI/ML community.
